name: issue-implement-non-trigger
description: An ordinary feature implementation request is offered the editorial skill description without its body. Stage outside any SKILL.md ancestor; source changes for the requested feature are permitted. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root. eval.json and oracle/ are grader-only; follow evals/README.md.
prompt: Implement https://github.example.invalid/acme/greeting/issues/23. The offline issue is in issue.md; update greeting.py to support it.
trap: An issue URL routes ordinary execution into description clarification, or the evaluator replaces the natural work request with classification-only instructions.

assertions.text: Treats the request as ordinary implementation work (source edits/checks are permitted); does not select $kk:clarify-docs merely because the request contains an issue URL.
Does not load the clarify-docs SKILL.md body or shared document-clarity procedure; only its skill-selection description is exposed initially.
Leaves issue.md byte-for-byte unchanged and creates no editorial issue draft, replacement title, summary or remote publication.
Handles the staged implementation request normally without network/external writes; implementation correctness is outside this editorial-boundary grade.
